constraints.definition: CHECK (last_error_code IS NULL OR length(last_error_code) >= 1 AND length(last_error_code) <= 160)

constraints.definition: CHECK (last_error_metadata IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(last_error_metadata) = 'object'::text AND pg_column_size(last_error_metadata) <= 8192)

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES private.v3_domain_events(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: v3_domain_event_outbox_lifecycle_check

constraints.definition: CHECK (subsystems ?& ARRAY['confirmations'::text, 'submissions'::text, 'juryVoting'::text, 'televoting'::text, 'results'::text, 'predictions'::text] AND ((subsystems ->> 'confirmations'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['not_started'::text, 'open'::text, 'paused'::text, 'closed'::text, 'locked'::text, 'verified'::text, 'published'::text])) AND ((subsystems ->> 'submissions'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['not_started'::text, 'open'::text, 'paused'::text, 'closed'::text, 'locked'::text, 'verified'::text, 'published'::text])) AND ((subsystems ->> 'juryVoting'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['not_started'::text, 'open'::text, 'paused'::text, 'closed'::text, 'locked'::text, 'verified'::text, 'published'::text])) AND ((subsystems ->> 'televoting'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['not_started'::text, 'open'::text, 'paused'::text, 'closed'::text, 'locked'::text, 'verified'::text, 'published'::text])) AND ((subsystems ->> 'results'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['not_started'::text, 'open'::text, 'paused'::text, 'closed'::text, 'locked'::text, 'verified'::text, 'published'::text])) AND ((subsystems ->> 'predictions'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['not_started'::text, 'open'::text, 'paused'::text, 'closed'::text, 'locked'::text, 'verified'::text, 'published'::text])))
